note: PROPOSED only -- not usable as admission/signing evidence until an owner signs it. No value below was chosen or adjusted to improve any observed Large-SMC economic result; none has been computed or inspected by this mission.

pip_size.source: MT5 symbol-metadata capture, 5-digit broker (tick_size=1e-05), already documented in src/fx_friction_research/cost_model.py's PIP_SIZE table for EURUSD -- a symbol-level broker fact, not tied to any one strategy's trading rules.

tick_size.source: Same MT5 symbol-metadata capture as above.

spread_pips.source: Documented industry-typical figure for a retail ECN/STP EURUSD account (same literature-sourced figure already used, with the same caveat, by src/fx_friction_research/cost_model.py's BASE scenario) -- NOT a Vantage-specific measured historical fact for Large SMC or any strategy.

commission_pips.source: Same industry-typical estimate as above (~$7/round-turn/standard-lot expressed as pip-equivalent).

slippage_pips.source: Same conservative industry-typical estimate as above.

cost_components.round_trip_cost_representation: Single one-time pip cost applied per trade at resolution (spread+commission+slippage summed once, not doubled for entry+exit) -- same convention as fx_friction_research.cost_model.CostScenario.total_friction_pips.

deliberately_not_reused.item: ST_ASIAN_SWEEP_5R_V1's own STRESSED/SEVERE cost scenarios (fx_friction_research/cost_model.py SCENARIOS)
deliberately_not_reused.reason: Those scenarios are anchored to ST_ASIAN_SWEEP_5R_V1's own SIGNED strategy config (max_spread_allowed_pips=2.0, slippage_limit_points=10 -- strategies/ST_ASIAN_SWEEP_5R_V1.yaml:110-111), which is that strategy's own risk tolerance, not a generic broker fact. ST_LARGE_SMC_V1 has no equivalent signed field. Reusing another strategy's own configured tolerance as if it were Large-SMC's own would misattribute a strategy-specific governance decision. Only the instrument-level facts (pip_size/tick_size) and the literature-sourced BASE-tier cost estimates are reused here; the strategy-anchored STRESSED/SEVERE tiers are not.
